value.Title: Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus  -  Democratic Republic of the Congo
value.Overview: On 14 August 2026, the Ministry of Health reported an outbreak.
value.Epidemiology: As of 14 August, 4665 confirmed cases, including 2184 deaths, have been reported.
value.Assessment: WHO assesses the risk at national level as high.
